## CHAPTER XXX.

### On the Reign of the Sun.

Now you approach the end of your work, and you have almost completed your business; now all things appear like the finest gold <note>original: "auri obryzi"</note>, and the <term>virgin’s milk</term> <gloss>a chemical solvent or liquid stage in the process</gloss>, with which you soak this matter, turns very yellow. Now render immortal thanks to God, the giver of all good things, who has led the work this far; pray to Him as a suppliant that He may guide your counsel from now on, lest by chance, while striving to hasten the work that is now almost perfect, you lose it entirely. Consider now that you have waited for almost seven months, and it will not be healthy to annihilate everything in a single hour. Therefore be very cautious, all the more as you are closer to perfection. If you proceed cautiously, these notable things will occur to you: first you will observe a certain yellow sweat on the body, and finally yellow vapors, with the body subsiding, tinted with violet, and sometimes with a dark purple.
